title: Code reusability in object-oriented programming
answer: Code reusability means designing behavior so multiple types or features can use existing logic instead of copying it. In OOP this can come from inheritance, interfaces with shared contracts or default methods, composition, helper classes, and polymorphism. AeroTopo's `Product` base class centralizes identity, tile storage, export behavior, equality, hashing, and string representation, while `Orthomosaic` and `Dem` reuse that implementation and provide only their specific resolution logic. Reuse should reduce duplication without creating unnecessary inheritance coupling.
